preconditions.note: GPIO18 is Vext and gates the e-ink 3V3 rail, active HIGH. With it low the panel controller is unpowered, BUSY floats, and every refresh appears to succeed. Assert it and let it settle BEFORE the sequence.

busy_ms.why: A full e-paper refresh cannot physically complete in tens of milliseconds - the particles take hundreds of milliseconds to move. An implausibly fast success means the panel power-enable line is low and the controller is unpowered, so BUSY floats and every refresh appears to succeed. Treat a fast success as a FAULT. Do not widen this band.

assert_ms.why: The controller should raise BUSY promptly once triggered. A long delay before it asserts means it is still booting, or the trigger is not reaching it.

requires_transition.why: E-ink retains its last image with no power. A static demo picture survives a dead driver, a wiped flash and an unpowered board, so seeing an image on the panel proves nothing. Only a change you watched happen counts as evidence - here, a BUSY line that asserted and then released.
